title: The Fungal Implantation Pylon
subtitle: One scar, set in the flesh
text: The Pylon installs, replaces or removes one cultivated fungal scar. It gives no extra slot. At Degree 4 it is raised as a Working craft. Build its frame beside the Cardinal Focus of a Lesser Working floor or larger, seat a Hyphal Substrate in the Focus and light Neurotic Spores and Bone Meal in the braziers. Feed the frame 1,200 mL and the floor takes it.
